subject: psychology
title: Recognising Bullying Adventure
welcome_lead: Some friendships turn nasty. Spot the signs. 🛑
meta_desc: Friendship & Bullying Adventure 2 — KS3 Psychology on bullying types and recognising it.
final_note: You learned the main types of bullying and how to recognise it.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Bullying is:

  • Repeated — not a one-off.
  • Hurtful — meant to harm.
  • Power imbalance — bully has more strength, status or numbers.

• Physical — hits, pushing, taking things.
  • Verbal — insults, threats.
  • Social — leaving someone out, rumours.
  • Cyberbullying — nasty messages, screenshots, fake accounts.

Warning signs in a friend:

  • Not wanting to go to school.
  • Losing things, bruises.
  • Mood changes.
  • Hiding their phone.

If you see it, you're a bystander — and you can help. 🛑
